capabilities.name: Governed Rule Certification
capabilities.responsibility: Certify whether governed evidence satisfies an explicit topic and version expectation by combining stable topic-completeness evaluation with deterministic certification outcome derivation, including bounded insurer and rule-family implementations.
capabilities.authority_role: Certification authority over declared governed-rule expectations only; it does not resolve evidence, publish facts, or grant downstream recommendation authority.
safety_invariants: Certification operates on governed EvidenceResolverOutput and does not perform evidence resolution.
The generic runner contains no insurer-specific authority; bounded insurer and rule-family modules remain implementations under the same certification responsibility.
Certification outcome is distinct from publication permission and authoritative publication.
Topic completeness requirements are evaluated through the existing topic-completeness boundary rather than duplicated inside certification.
capabilities.notes: Product/topic-specific certification modules are bounded implementations of this capability, not separate architectural authorities. Topic-profile and topic-completeness ownership remain outside this record for later census.

capabilities.name: Governed Publication Decision
capabilities.responsibility: Evaluate certified governed knowledge for explicit PUBLISH, WITHHOLD, or BLOCKED eligibility while preserving certification limitations and evidence/certification trace references.
capabilities.authority_role: Determines publication permission only; it explicitly does not create an authoritative publication record.
safety_invariants: FAIL or BLOCKED certification cannot proceed to publication.
Certification limitations and trace references must be preserved.
A PUBLISH decision sets publication permission but authoritative_publication_created remains false.
bound_not_published limitations block publication rather than being silently removed.
capabilities.notes: Publication eligibility is a separate governed state from both rule certification and authoritative publication.

capabilities.name: Authoritative Publication Gate
capabilities.responsibility: Create an immutable authoritative publication record only from an approved PUBLISH decision and an exactly matching governed projection, failing closed on identity, certification, limitation, trace, or prohibited-language inconsistency.
capabilities.authority_role: Final authority for creating the governed authoritative-publication record; it cannot upgrade a WITHHOLD/BLOCKED decision or repair mismatched lineage.
safety_invariants: Only a PUBLISH decision with publication_permitted true and PASS certification may cross the gate.
Governed subject, certification, topic/version, limitations, and trace references must match exactly between decision and projection.
Republishing an already-created authoritative publication is prohibited.
Prohibited boundary or affirmative claim-payment guarantee language fails closed.
capabilities.notes: This capability is downstream of publication decision; publication permission alone is not an authoritative record.

capabilities.name: Insurance Intelligence Coverage Registry
capabilities.responsibility: Maintain a validated immutable inventory of insurer product/version lifecycle, evidence coverage, concept coverage, and downstream readiness states with explicit evidence references and limitations.
capabilities.authority_role: Inventory/readiness authority only; it does not resolve product identity, invent insurance facts, rank products, or authorize recommendations.
safety_invariants: Known product lifecycle status requires evidence references and a verification timestamp.
Concept readiness cannot exceed its governed coverage state.
Partial, source-limited, blocked, or non-automated states preserve explicit limitations.
capabilities.notes: Health seed data and reporting are implementations/views of the registry. Product identity resolution and decision support remain separately governed capabilities.
